title: Summoning request v1
description: One generation request for a bot's Specter, as GET /api/summonings/{requestId} and the summoning routes report it. status is the lifecycle of the request, never a property of the character: queued and running while the generator works, ready when a validated candidate is waiting for the user, accepted when the user accepted it, failed with an error code, cancelled when the user stopped it, superseded when another candidate was accepted first. candidate holds the validated profile only while status is ready or accepted; it is never raw model text. keep names the profile fields the user asked to hold fixed on a reroll; the writer overwrites them with the current accepted values, so the model cannot change them. error is an api-error style code (timeout, refused, malformed, unavailable, interrupted, and similar) and is null unless status is failed. promptVersion is the fixed prompt version in force when the request ran. The budget block is what is left in the rolling window for this bot and for the install. A request created by this app is internal summoning work and is never an attempt or an input to experience.
